title: Android rolls out local ‘Documents’ backup that syncs to Google Drive
summary: Google now lets Android users automatically upload files and other downloads from their phone or tablet to Google Drive thanks to a new “Documents” backup. Specifically, a new “Android backups” folder will be added to your My Drive.
